reasons: This is the experiment-level research verdict, not an event-level technician or causal decision.
The selected five-minute detector recorded 153 healthy alert runs over 1794.5067 supported hours (0.08526/hour), above its frozen <=0.05/hour target.
Energy deviation is measured-versus-modelled evidence; the unshaded experimental inverter counterfactual and recoverable electricity are unconfirmed.

event_context.label_source: Known-zero Fault labels in the V2 source; absence of a label is not proof of a physically fault-free system.
event_context.note: Comparison interval lies within the frozen detector-calibration dates; it is not an independent post-selection test.

limitations: This one-hour zero-labelled comparison lies inside the detector calibration period and is not an independent holdout.
Zero Fault labels do not rule out unrecorded faults or prove the plant was physically healthy.
Positive signed or positive-only deviation in a labelled-healthy interval demonstrates model error; it is not recovered energy.
The V2 experiment-level detector verdict remains LIMIT; these interval values do not change the frozen result.
The series contains five-minute means plotted at bin midpoints; energy metrics come from the original supported source records.

metrics.definition: Mean absolute error of model-expected minus measured experimental AC power.
metrics.population: Later zero-labelled daylight population; 24,320 common weather-eligible bins over 235 days.

metrics.calculation: Committed V2 nMAE; numerator is MAE and denominator is mean_observed_w.
metrics.definition: Healthy-labelled MAE divided by mean measured experimental AC power.
metrics.population: zero-labelled, supported daylight five-minute bins in the later stability period; n=24320 over the committed evaluation output

metrics.definition: Mean expected-minus-measured AC power; positive means model prediction is higher.
metrics.population: zero-labelled, supported daylight five-minute bins in the later stability period; n=24320 over the committed evaluation output

metrics.calculation: Detected grouped interventions divided by all grouped interventions; retrospective label overlap rule.
metrics.definition: Fraction of documented intervention episodes with a detector confirmation within the event span.
metrics.population: All 23 retrospectively grouped documented shading interventions on one installation.

metrics.calculation: Committed V2 five-minute detector evaluation; mixed-label boundary alerts excluded.
metrics.definition: Contiguous alert runs whose support is all zero-labelled, divided by evaluated supported hours.
metrics.population: Later zero-labelled supported healthy-window evaluation population.

metrics.calculation: Trapezoids over actual elapsed UTC seconds on valid consecutive source records; no bridging gaps or unlabelled pauses.
metrics.definition: Integral of healthy expected target AC power minus measured target AC power; may be negative.
metrics.population: Original source-record intervals in this known-zero-label comparison window; 719 supported intervals over 3,595 seconds.

metrics.calculation: Same valid intervals as signed deviation; positive endpoints are clipped before trapezoidal integration, so zero crossing is approximate.
metrics.definition: Integral of endpoint residuals clipped at zero; not recoverable or commercial energy.
metrics.population: Original source-record intervals in the recorded zero-labelled example window; only eligible adjacent intervals with 0<dt<=18 s.

metrics.calculation: Source-derived trapezoidal elapsed-time integral over the same intervals as signed deviation.
metrics.definition: Integrated measured target AC energy over the same valid intervals.
metrics.population: Original source-record intervals in the recorded zero-labelled example window; only eligible adjacent intervals with 0<dt<=18 s.

metrics.calculation: Source-derived trapezoidal elapsed-time integral over the same intervals as signed deviation.
metrics.definition: Integrated calibrated healthy model-expected target AC energy over the same valid intervals.
metrics.population: Original source-record intervals in the recorded zero-labelled example window; only eligible adjacent intervals with 0<dt<=18 s.
